description: This file defines a nested class LogExtentBuilder.ReadOnlyStream which is a read-only stream implementation for the Orleans.Journaling namespace, providing mechanisms to read data from a log extent with seeking and copying capabilities.

classes.name: LogExtentBuilder.ReadOnlyStream
classes.description: A read-only stream implementation that facilitates reading from a log extent managed by LogExtentBuilder, supporting seeking, copying, and asynchronous read operations.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Adjusts the current read position based on offset and origin.

methods.name: SetPosition
methods.description: Sets the read position within the stream, validating bounds.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads data into a memory buffer.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies data to another stream, synchronously.

methods.name: CopyToAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously copies data to another stream.

methods.name: SetBuilder
methods.description: Associates a LogExtentBuilder instance with this read-only stream and resets position/length.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream's internal state by clearing the builder and resetting position/length.

methods.name: ComputeLength
methods.description: Calculates the total length of the stream based on the buffer and entry lengths.

methods.name: GetVarIntWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width in bytes of a variable-length integer encoding.

methods.name: GetReadOnlyException
methods.description: Generates a NotSupportedException indicating the stream is read-only.
